question: How do universal immanence and iconic adornment define the deity receiving obeisance?
premises: The deity contains all selves within.
The deity bears the Kaustubha jewel.
Obeisance is offered to both aspects.
inference: The deity is honored both as the all-containing self and as the bearer of the Kaustubha.
plain_english: Obeisance to you, O one who contains all selves; obeisance to you, O bearer of the Kaustubha.
